ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle B = \angle C = 90^\circ$, $M$ is the midpoint of $BC$, $DM$ bisects $\angle ADC$, and $\angle ADC = 110^\circ$, find the degree measure of $\angle MAB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw $MN \perp AD$ at N,\\
$\because$ $\angle B = \angle C = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $AB \parallel CD$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle DAB = 180^\circ - \angle ADC = 70^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $DM$ bisects $\angle ADC$, $MN \perp AD$, $MC \perp CD$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle DMN = \angle DMC$, $\angle DNM = \angle DCM = 90^\circ$,\\
In $\triangle DMN$ and $\triangle DMC$,\\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle DMN = \angle DMC \\
\angle DNM = \angle DCM \\
DM = DM
\end{array}\right.$\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle DMN \cong \triangle DMC$ (AAS),\\
$\therefore$ $MN = MC$.\\
$\because$ M is the midpoint of $BC$,\\
$\therefore$ $MC = MB$,\\
$\therefore$ $MN = MB$,\\
And since $MN \perp AD$, $MB \perp AB$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle MAB = \frac{1}{2}\angle DAB = \boxed{35^\circ}$.

Set A=(0,0), let AB lie on the positive x-axis, and let B=(b,0), M=(b,h), C=(b,2h). Since CD is parallel to AB, write D=(d,2h). Because ∠ADC=110°, the supplementary angle ∠DAB is 70°, so AD makes a 70° angle with AB; hence tan70°=2h/d, giving d=2h cot70°. Since DM bisects ∠ADC=110°, the ray DM makes 55° with DC downward toward M, so tan55°=h/(b−d), giving b−d=h cot55°. Therefore b/h=2cot70°+cot55°. Use the identity 2cot70°+cot55°=cot35° to get h/b=tan35°. Since ∠MAB is the angle that AM makes with AB and tan∠MAB=h/b, conclude ∠MAB=35°.

图像描述：图中 A 在左下，B 在右下，C 在右上，D 在左上方；AB 近似水平，BC 竖直，CD 水平，M 在 BC 上且约为中点；连接了 AD、DM、AM。由图可按题设取 AB 为水平正方向、BC 为竖直方向、CD 与 AB 平行。

推理：按指定坐标法，设 A=(0,0)，AB 在 x 轴正方向上，B=(b,0)。因为 M 是 BC 的中点，设 M=(b,h)，C=(b,2h)。又 CD 与 AB 平行，所以 D=(d,2h)。由 ∠B=∠C=90° 可知 AB ∥ CD，因此 ∠DAB 与 ∠ADC 互补，∠DAB=180°-110°=70°。于是直线 AD 与 AB 的夹角为 70°，所以 tan70°=2h/d，得到 d=2h cot70°。因为 DM 平分 ∠ADC=110°，所以 DM 与水平的 DC 向下夹角为 55°。从 D=(d,2h) 到 M=(b,h)，水平差为 b-d，竖直下降为 h，因此 tan55°=h/(b-d)，即 b-d=h cot55°。于是 b=d+h cot55°=2h cot70°+h cot55°，所以 b/h=2cot70°+cot55°。利用恒等式 2cot70°+cot55°=cot35°，得 b/h=cot35°，从而 h/b=tan35°。而 ∠MAB 是 AM 与 AB 的夹角，tan∠MAB=h/b=tan35°，所以 ∠MAB=35°。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, $\angle B = \angle C = 90^\circ$, $M$ is the midpoint of $BC$, $DM$ bisects $\angle ADC$, and $\angle ADC = 110^\circ$, find the degree measure of $\angle MAB$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw $MN \perp AD$ at N,\\
$\because$ $\angle B = \angle C = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $AB \parallel CD$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle DAB = 180^\circ - \angle ADC = 70^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $DM$ bisects $\angle ADC$, $MN \perp AD$, $MC \perp CD$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle DMN = \angle DMC$, $\angle DNM = \angle DCM = 90^\circ$,\\
In $\triangle DMN$ and $\triangle DMC$,\\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle DMN = \angle DMC \\
\angle DNM = \angle DCM \\
DM = DM
\end{array}\right.$\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle DMN \cong \triangle DMC$ (AAS),\\
$\therefore$ $MN = MC$.\\
$\because$ M is the midpoint of $BC$,\\
$\therefore$ $MC = MB$,\\
$\therefore$ $MN = MB$,\\
And since $MN \perp AD$, $MB \perp AB$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle MAB = \frac{1}{2}\angle DAB = \boxed{35^\circ}$.

Point M is on BC, AM and DM are connected in the figure, and M is located inside angle DAB.

Reasoning: From the given ∠B = ∠C = 90°, it can be known that AB and CD are both perpendicular to BC, so AB ∥ CD. AD serves as a transversal, therefore ∠DAB and ∠ADC are supplementary, so ∠DAB = 180° - 110° = 70°. Because DM bisects ∠ADC, and M is on this angle bisector, the perpendicular distances from M to AD and CD are equal. Also because M is the midpoint of BC, MB = MC; and BC is perpendicular to AB and CD, so MB is the perpendicular distance from M to AB, and MC is the perpendicular distance from M to CD, therefore the perpendicular distances from M to AB and CD are equal. Thus the perpendicular distances from M to AD and AB are equal. In the figure, M is inside ∠DAB; according to the distance property of an angle bisector, AM is the angle bisector of ∠DAB. Therefore ∠MAB = 70° / 2 = 35°.
